conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: Both builds deliver an identical core quickstart flow (prerequisites, install, auth, safe-preview vs publish, node-version fix) with facts matching the brief exactly, so the deciding factor is documentation completeness. A's sidebar explicitly disables two of the six documented sections (Guides, CI) as inert, tooltip-marked 'Not included in this preview' entries, and its CLI reference is a short prose recap rather than a real reference; B implements all six sections as working anchors with a structured, scannable CLI reference matching the facts. That better serves the stated job of finding the right reference if blocked, even though A has a stronger accessibility/motion-reduction baseline.
suspected_unblinding: none — no builder-identifying markers found in sanitized source or evidence
